'''November 2000 Davis tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Davis, California on 11 November 2000. [[Kyle Ishimaru]] won it. It is known from Kyle Ishimaru's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1451">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-12-davis-california-11-11-00d1451/ davis-california-11-11-00], DeckTech (Kyle "Psyokid" Ishimaru, 12 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-12-davis-california-11-11-00d1451/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Davis, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Kyle Ishimaru]]
